name: AM Quartex
description: AM combine deep expertise in digital primary source publishing with the technology to enhance access and discovery. Blending high-quality content with a platform built to surface and showcase unique digital assets, AM transform rare archival materials into essential research and learning experiences.

name: TIND
description: TIND is an official CERN spin-off providing commercial library management systems, digital preservation, and research data management solutions based on CERN open-source software. Serving academic, public, and special research libraries around the globe, TIND is headquartered in Oslo, Norway.

name: ResourceSpace
description: ResourceSpace is a powerful, digital asset management system trusted by libraries, archives, museums, universities and galleries worldwide. We help organisations securely organise, describe, preserve, discover and share digital collections. Flexible metadata, granular permissions, configurable workflows, advanced search and integrations - including IIIF and leading collections management systems - allow the platform to adapt to complex institutional needs. We’re employee owned, ethical and experienced and ResourceSpace combines enterprise functionality with transparent pricing, expert support and freedom from vendor lock-in.

name: HathiTrust
description: HathiTrust, founded in 2008 as a not-for-profit collaborative of academic and research libraries, now preserves more than 19 million digitized items in its digital library, which originated as curated print items from academic library collections.  HathiTrust offers reading access to the fullest extent allowable by U.S. and international copyright law and explores opportunities to strengthen academic libraries by delivering new and emerging services based on the collection. It contributes to research, scholarship, and the public good by collaboratively collecting, organizing, preserving, and sharing the record of human knowledge.
